reference.title: Build messages
reference.shortdesc: Every message the plugin itself can write to the build log — what it means, what the build did, and what to do about it.

section.p: build messagesGOVK codesThe plugin's messages carry codes of the form GOVKnnn followed by W (warning) or E (error), in the toolkit's format, with the source file and line where one applies. Warnings never fail a build; the two things that stop a build are invalid parameter values, refused before any processing, and the toolkit's own fatal conditions. Messages from the toolkit itself have DOTX, DOTJ and DOTA codes; the ones met in practice are discussed in .

row.entry: When, and what the build did

A navigation entry has a keyref the toolkit did not resolve — DITA-OT resolves no key inside a submap that is itself included with <mapref keyref>. The entry is rendered without a link and without children; reported once per affected branch.
Include that submap with <mapref href>, or check that the key is defined. See .
govuk.search.ranking is neither a preset nor a JSON object Pagefind can read. Pagefind's default scoring applies; values that are plainly wrong are refused earlier by the build.
Use default, reference, or a JSON object of ranking options. See .
govuk.print=yes, but the publication has more topic files than govuk.print.max-topics. No print document is written and no page links to one.
Raise the ceiling, or build print documents per part from submaps. Very large publications are not one printable document. See .

An inlined SVG diagram carries active or remote content — script, foreignObject, event-handler attributes, script-scheme links or references to other origins. Removed under govuk.svg.sanitize=yes (the default); kept under no. Reported once per reference.
Keep diagrams static, or accept the removal. See .
An SVG or MathML reference points outside the input directory. Under govuk.inline.scope=input (the default) the file is not read and the reference renders as an image; under any it is inlined.
Move the file into the publication, or set govuk.inline.scope=any when inlining from elsewhere on the build machine is intended.

The content policy found a remote image or SVG reference, an object embed or a script-scheme link; the message names the kind, the value and whether it was kept (govuk.content.policy=warn) or replaced by a placeholder (strip).
Host the resource with the publication, change the link, or choose strip. govuk.content.warnings=no silences the report. See .

The PDF command (govuk.pdf.command) failed, or was set without govuk.print=yes, or there was no print document to render. The site is complete; no PDF was produced. Reported by the build step rather than the transformation, so it carries no file and line.
Check the command runs by hand on print.html, and that govuk.print=yes. See .
A Content-Security-Policy is in force (govuk.csp) and content that was kept — a remote image or object — will be blocked by it in the browser.
Host the resource with the publication, strip it, or set govuk.csp to a policy that allows its origin.

section.title: Messages from the toolkit
section.p: Two DITA-OT behaviours produce messages that look like plugin faults but are not: the 4.4 chunk compatibility mode (Failed to move chunk and the DOTX cascade that follows) and unresolved keys inside keyref'd maprefs. Both, with their remedies, are in . An Error: Failed to read image … metadata line appears when the toolkit cannot open an image to measure it — for example a remote image, which the content policy also reports; it does not stop the build.
